# Add normalizeSlug helper

- **Status:** draft
- **Branch:** feature/eng-42-normalize-slug
- **Issue:** ENG-42

## Intent

Callers in `loops-demo` need a shared helper that converts raw text into clean lowercase hyphen-separated slugs. Adding `normalizeSlug` in `src/slug.ts` standardizes slug formatting and prevents ad-hoc string cleanup across modules.

## Requirements

- Export `normalizeSlug(input: string): string` from `src/slug.ts`.
- Trim leading and trailing whitespace and hyphens, convert uppercase letters to lowercase, and collapse internal whitespace and hyphen runs into single `-` separators.
- Return `""` when the input contains only whitespace or hyphens.
- Follow `AGENTS.md` file organization (`// Constants` and `// API` dividers) and colocate unit tests in `src/slug.test.ts` verified with `bun test`.
- Non-goals: transliterating Unicode diacritics, stripping non-separator punctuation, or changing existing `src/reviewed-module.ts` exports.

## Design

### Big Ideas

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Caller["Caller input: string"] --> TrimLower["Trim whitespace + lowercase"]
  TrimLower --> Split["Split on whitespace/hyphen runs"]
  Split --> Join["Filter empty tokens + join with '-'"]
  Join --> Slug["Normalized slug: string"]
```

- `src/slug.ts` owns slug normalization as a pure synchronous function with zero external dependencies.
- Splitting on `/[\s-]+/` and filtering empty parts removes leading, trailing, and repeated hyphens in one pass.

### Infrastructure Changes

N/A.

### Interfaces

```ts
// src/slug.ts
export function normalizeSlug(input: string): string
```

- `normalizeSlug("  Hello-World  ")` returns `"hello-world"`.
- `normalizeSlug("  Foo - Bar -- Baz  ")` returns `"foo-bar-baz"`.
- `normalizeSlug("   ---   ")` returns `""`.

### Consequences

#### Repo Changes

```text
[M] modified  [A] added  [D] deleted  [R] renamed
src/
├── [A] slug.ts        exports normalizeSlug helper (largest edit)
└── [A] slug.test.ts   colocated Bun unit tests for normalizeSlug
```

Nothing is removed or renamed.

#### Testing

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Call["Call normalizeSlug(input)"] --> EmptyCheck{"Contains non-separator tokens?"}
  EmptyCheck -->|"no (empty, spaces, or hyphens only)"| EmptyOut["Return empty string ''"]
  EmptyCheck -->|"yes (single or multiple words)"| Tokens["State: Lowercase word token list"]
  MixedCase["Mixed case + surrounding spaces"] --> Tokens
  MultiSep["Repeated spaces + hyphens"] --> Tokens
  Tokens --> JoinHyphen["Join tokens with single '-'"]
```

```text
src/
└── [A] slug.test.ts
    └── [A] given normalizeSlug
        ├── [A] when input is empty or contains only spaces and hyphens, then it returns an empty string
        ├── [A] when input has surrounding spaces and uppercase letters, then it returns trimmed lowercase hyphenated words
        └── [A] when words have repeated spaces or hyphens, then it collapses separators into single hyphens
```

`bun test` executes `src/slug.test.ts` directly and prints pass/fail assertions for each behavioral branch.

#### Trade-offs

- Non-whitespace punctuation stays inside word tokens because `ENG-42` scopes normalization to trimming and lowercasing hyphen-separated words.
- Keeping `normalizeSlug` in a dedicated `src/slug.ts` module matches the objective contract without coupling to `src/reviewed-module.ts`.

## Phases

### Phase 1: Implement normalizeSlug and unit tests

- [ ] Add `src/slug.ts` with `// Constants` and `// API` dividers and export `normalizeSlug(input: string): string`.
- [ ] Add `src/slug.test.ts` with `bun:test` BDD cases matching the behavior flowchart and clear Arrange, Act, and Assert steps.
- [ ] Validation
  - [ ] Run `bun test` and confirm both `src/slug.test.ts` and `src/reviewed-module.test.ts` pass.
  - [ ] Confirm `src/slug.ts` and `src/slug.test.ts` follow `AGENTS.md` section dividers and colocation rules.
  - [ ] Commit scoped changes and confirm remote CI is green for the pushed branch head when authorized by the active workflow.

## References

- Issue `ENG-42`: Add `normalizeSlug` helper in `src/slug.ts` with unit tests in `src/slug.test.ts`.
- Repository rules in `AGENTS.md` (`// Constants`, `// Types`, `// API`, `// Helpers` dividers and colocated `.test.ts` suites run with `bun test`).
